recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5189 unless PA wants to revisit the broader Person Client Portal guidance independently of this historical ballot comment.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA change request from Jan 2015 Ballot Comment #63 asking to remove a Person sentence about organizations letting patients manage demographic data while maintaining stricter control of associated Patient resource data, and to add a Client Portal use-case section where that idea was relevant.
initial_application: The 2015-03-17 Person ballot reconciliation commit dc2afae9f6e31b220e90a9d948c46e3743363e68, whose subject includes tracker 5189, removed the exact challenged sentence from source/person/person-introduction.xml and added the Client Portal narrative to source/person/person-notes.xml.
additional_context: Person and RelatedPerson are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current Person introduction text no longer contains the challenged access-control sentence; current Person notes retain the Client Portal section with Patient and RelatedPerson link usage and security/privacy guidance nearby. Current RelatedPerson narrative has no conflicting use-case text. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no directly relevant later or conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope Person source already matches the final Jira request: the misleading sentence is absent and the Client Portal use case is present.
